versions.content: [SWS_Can_00012] Upstream requirements: SRS_Can_01059 ⌈The Can module shall guarantee that neither the ISRs nor the function Can_- MainFunction_Read can be interrupted by itself. The CAN hardware (or shadow) buffer is always consistent, because it is written and read in sequence in exactly one function that is never interrupted by itself. ⌋ If the CAN hardware cannot be configured to lock the RX hardware object after recep- tion (hardware feature), it could happen that the hardware buffer is overwritten by a newly arrived message.
